description: Orbit is a team focused on advancing astronaut health monitoring through innovative technology, space science, and data-driven solutions for safer space exploration.
summary:
Orbit 1 is an optimized Laravel-based NASA astronaut health platform for efficient mission-readiness monitoring. Astronauts complete daily assessments covering sleep, exercise, mood, energy, isolation, and physical discomfort. The system processes this data in real time to generate readiness scores, health statuses, personalized guidance, vital metrics, and hazard indicators.

Real time-driven data readiness, sleep, heart rate, and temperature trends. Automated daily validation prompts astronauts when an assessment is missing.

Orbit supports early risk detection, improves health decision-making, and helps protect astronaut safety, performance, and mission success during long-duration space missions.
details:
- Daily astronaut health assessment for sleep, exercise, discomfort, mood, isolation, and energy.

- Mission-readiness score generated from validated health inputs.

- Body-system monitoring for brain, heart, bones, eyes, and immune system.

- Simulated biometric telemetry: heart rate, blood pressure, temperature, glucose, and sleep duration.

- Monitoring of NASA’s five human-spaceflight hazards.

- Historical health trend visualization using ApexCharts.

- Personalized action guidance and risk recommendations.

- Flight Surgeon communication workflow.

- Centralized dashboard with modal-based information access.

- Responsive NASA-inspired HUD interface.

- Repository Pattern and Service Layer architecture.

- SOLID-oriented, modular, and scalable Laravel implementation.
